Script.name: shopwin
Script.script:
--[[ Shop window Sean Stoves, 2026-08-02 'list' in a shop, copied into a panel as rows you can click to buy from. The MUD's own list still scrolls past in the main window - this is an extra, and the extra is that the rows are buttons. The MUD's own output, which is what this reads: Num Level Price Qty Item --- ----- ------- --- ----------------------------------- 1 5 20 --- [Potion] Optical Precision 7 69 625 1 (Polished) plain tunic 19 50 600 1 a steel spear Quantity '---' means unlimited supply. Fixed width, and the Num column is the whole point: Aardwolf's 'buy' takes that number, so a row can be a button without guessing at keywords the way the hunt links have to. Qty is '---' for unlimited or a count for limited stock, and a sold-out line simply isn't listed. One press, one command. Clicking a row sends 'buy ' and nothing else - no confirm dialog, but also no chaining into wearing or wielding it. That's the same line the S&D panel draws: the client saves you typing, it doesn't play for you. Prices are not checked against your gold. The MUD already says no better than we could, and a client that greys out what it thinks you can't afford is wrong the moment you sell something. ]] aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.shopwin = aardkit.shopwin or {} local SH = aardkit.shopwin local U = aardkit.util.named("Shop") local CFG = U.load("shopwin", { on = true, gag = false, -- a copy by default; the MUD's own list still prints }) local ROW_H, PAD, HEAD_H, BAR_H, FOOT_H = 20, 4, 18, 20, 16 -- declared ahead of the closures below so they bind these locals and not -- globals of the same name, which are nil forever local panel, rows, head, items, page, pages, btns items, rows, page, pages, btns = {}, {}, 1, 1, {} panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "shop", title = "Shop", width = 520, height = 420, x = "200px", y = "120px", fontSize = 10, consoleless = true, transient = true, onresize = function() if aardkit.shopwin.paint then aardkit.shopwin.paint() end end, onbuild = function() rows, head, btns = {}, nil, {} if aardkit.shopwin.paint then aardkit.shopwin.paint() end end, }) SH.panel = panel local COL = { row = "#141b2d", hover = "#274060", text = "#c8d0dc", dim = "#8a93a8", lvl = "#3ad07a", border = "#3a4a6b", accent = "#e94560", } --- -- capture --- -- Aardwolf paints item names, and the colour carries meaning - the bonus-loot -- bracket tier, and shop items that are quest or clan gear. Read it off the -- line rather than deciding for ourselves what an item should look like. local function colour_of(text) if not text or text == "" then return COL.text end if not pcall(selectString, text, 1) then return COL.text end local ok, r, g, b = pcall(getFgColor) if not ok or not r then return COL.text end return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", r, g, b) end -- Rows are only taken between the header and the footer. The row pattern -- matched nothing outside a shop list across every session logged, so this is -- belt and braces rather than a fix - but it's two lines, and it means the -- module can only ever react to output it has seen the start of. local listing, listing_t local function listing_off() listing = false if listing_t then pcall(killTimer, listing_t); listing_t = nil end end function SH.on_head() if not CFG.on then return end items, page = {}, 1 listing_off() listing = true -- a list with no footer would otherwise leave this armed for the session listing_t = tempTimer(10, listing_off) if CFG.gag then U.gag() end end -- " 1 5 20 --- [Potion] Optical Precision" function SH.on_row(num, lvl, price, qty, item) if not (CFG.on and listing) then return end item = U.trim(item or "") if item == "" then return end items[#items + 1] = { num = tonumber(num) or 0, lvl = tonumber(lvl) or 0, price = tonumber((tostring(price or ""):gsub(",", ""))) or 0, qty = U.trim(qty or ""), item = item, col = colour_of(item), } if CFG.gag then U.gag() end panel:show() SH.paint() end -- the MUD's own footer, and the end of the list function SH.on_foot() if not (CFG.on and listing) then return end listing_off() if CFG.gag then U.gag() end SH.paint() end --- -- paint --- -- Monospaced, or the columns can't line up: a proportional font makes "60" and -- "105" different widths and the names start in different places on every row. local MONO = "font-family: 'Source Code Pro', 'Menlo', monospace;" local function label(store, key, h, cb, arg) if not store[key] then store[key] = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "aardkit_shop_" .. key .. "_" .. (panel.gen or 1), x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = h, }, panel.container) if cb then store[key]:setClickCallback(cb, arg) end end return store[key] end local function row_label(i) if not rows[i] then rows[i] = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "aardkit_shop_row" .. i .. "_" .. (panel.gen or 1), x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = ROW_H - 2, }, panel.container) rows[i]:setClickCallback("aardkit.shopwin.buy", i) end return rows[i] end -- HTML eats runs of spaces, so padding has to be non-breaking local function pad(s, n, right) s = tostring(s) local gap = n - #s if gap < 1 then return s end local sp = string.rep(" ", gap) return right and (sp .. s) or (s .. sp) end function SH.paint() if not panel.container then return end if not panel:visible() then return end local w = U.px(panel.container.get_width and panel.container:get_width() or panel.container.width) local h = U.px(panel.container.get_height and panel.container:get_height() or panel.container.height) if w < 80 then w = 520 end -- how much room the name gets, once the level and price columns are taken. -- roughly 7px a character at this size. local chars = math.max(20, math.floor((w - PAD * 2) / 7)) local LVL, PRICE = 4, 10 local NAME = math.max(10, chars - LVL - PRICE - 6) local hd = label(btns, "head", HEAD_H) hd:move(PAD, PAD) hd:resize(w - PAD * 2, HEAD_H) hd:setStyleSheet("background-color: #0d1117; border: 0px; " .. MONO) hd:echo(string.format(" %s  %s  %s", COL.dim, pad("Lvl", LVL, true), pad("Item", NAME), pad("Price", PRICE, true))) hd:show() local listy = PAD * 2 + HEAD_H local fits = math.max(1, math.floor((h - listy - BAR_H - FOOT_H - PAD * 3) / ROW_H)) pages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#items / fits)) page = math.min(math.max(1, page), pages) local first = (page - 1) * fits + 1 local last = math.min(#items, first + fits - 1) local slot = 0 for i = first, last do local e = items[i] slot = slot + 1 local l = row_label(slot) l:move(PAD, listy + (slot - 1) * ROW_H) l:resize(w - PAD * 2, ROW_H - 2) l:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 3px; %s", COL.row, COL.border, MONO)) local name = e.item if #name > NAME then name = name:sub(1, NAME - 1) .. "\226\128\166" end l:echo(string.format( " %s" .. "  %s" .. "  %s%s", COL.lvl, pad(e.lvl, LVL, true), e.col, pad(name, NAME), COL.dim, pad(U.commas(e.price), PRICE, true), e.qty ~= "---" and (" x" .. e.qty) or "")) l:setClickCallback("aardkit.shopwin.buy", i) l:show() end for i = slot + 1, #rows do rows[i]:hide() end -- page bar, with the warning under it local y, bw = math.max(0, h - BAR_H - FOOT_H - PAD * 2), 70 local back, fwd = page > 1, page < pages local function style(on) return string.format("background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 3px;", on and "#1b2540" or "#141b2d", on and "#3a4a6b" or "#232c44") end local function lab(on, t) return string.format("
%s
", on and "#c8d0dc" or "#4a5468", t) end local b = label(btns, "prev", BAR_H - 2, "aardkit.shopwin.prev") b:move(PAD, y); b:resize(bw, BAR_H - 2) b:setStyleSheet(style(back)); b:echo(lab(back, "< prev")); b:show() b = label(btns, "next", BAR_H - 2, "aardkit.shopwin.next") b:move(w - bw - PAD, y); b:resize(bw, BAR_H - 2) b:setStyleSheet(style(fwd)); b:echo(lab(fwd, "next >")); b:show() b = label(btns, "count", BAR_H - 2) b:move(PAD + bw + PAD, y); b:resize(math.max(10, w - (bw + PAD * 2) * 2), BAR_H - 2) b:setStyleSheet("background-color: #0d1117; border: 0px;") b:echo(string.format("
%s
", COL.dim, #items == 0 and "nothing listed" or (#items .. " for sale" .. (pages > 1 and (" - page " .. page .. " of " .. pages) or "")))) b:show() -- Say what a click does, where you'll see it before you click. There's no -- confirmation step and there shouldn't be one - a shop list you have to -- confirm twice is slower than typing 'buy 3' - but it should never be a -- surprise either. b = label(btns, "warn", FOOT_H) b:move(PAD, math.max(0, h - FOOT_H - PAD)) b:resize(w - PAD * 2, FOOT_H) b:setStyleSheet("background-color: #0d1117; border: 0px;") b:echo(string.format("
%s
", COL.accent, "clicking a row buys it at the price shown - there is no confirmation")) b:show() end function SH.prev() if page > 1 then page = page - 1; SH.paint() end end function SH.next() if page < pages then page = page + 1; SH.paint() end end -- the row index, not the shop's number - the list scrolls function SH.buy(i) local e = items[tonumber(i) or 0] if not e then return end send("buy " .. e.num, true) end --- -- commands --- function SH.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg) if verb == "toggle" then panel:toggle() elseif verb == "on" or verb == "off" then CFG.on = (verb == "on") U.save("shopwin", CFG) U.ok("Shop window " .. verb .. (CFG.on and " - 'list' is copied to the panel." or " - main window only.")) elseif verb == "gag" then CFG.gag = not CFG.gag U.save("shopwin", CFG) U.ok("Shop: " .. (CFG.gag and "panel only - the list is hidden from the main window." or "in both places.")) elseif verb == "up" or verb == "prev" then SH.prev() elseif verb == "down" or verb == "next" then SH.next() elseif verb == "buy" then local n = tonumber(U.trim(rest)) if not n then U.warn("Usage: shop buy ") else SH.buy(n) end elseif verb == "clear" then items, page = {}, 1 SH.paint() U.ok("Shop window cleared.") elseif verb == "dock" or verb == "embed" or verb == "show" or verb == "hide" then aardkit.panel.cmd("shop " .. verb) else U.help("Shop window", { { "shopwin toggle", "show or hide the panel" }, { "state", CFG.on and "on" or "off" }, { "main window", CFG.gag and "hidden - panel only" or "still prints there too" }, { "stock", #items > 0 and (#items .. " item(s) listed") or "nothing listed yet" }, { "" }, { "shopwin", "show or hide the panel" }, { "shopwin on | off", "copy 'list' to the panel, or main window only" }, { "shopwin gag", "hide it from the main window, or show it in both" }, { "shopwin up | down", "page through the list, same as the buttons" }, { "shopwin buy ", "same as clicking that row" }, { "shopwin clear", "empty it" }, { "shopwin dock | embed | show | hide", "panel placement" }, { "" }, { "Type 'list' in a shop. The MUD's own list still prints in the" }, { "main window; this is a clickable copy. A row sends 'buy '" }, { "and stops there - it won't wear or wield it for you." }, }) end end aardkit.register("shopwin", "shop stock in a panel, click a row to buy it", SH.cmd)
